name: Stash
description: Give Claude persistent cloud memory that survives beyond a single session. Developers can stash working state, share context between parallel agents, and coordinate multi-agent workflows using named text files. longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `stash` (Store and retrieve working memory using Agent Stash).

Installs with `claude plugin install stash@claude-community` from `mrusert/agent-stash-plugin`.

Give Claude persistent cloud memory that survives beyond a single session. Developers can stash working state, share context between parallel agents, and coordinate multi-agent workflows using named text files. Includes ephemeral stashes that auto-expire, persistent keeps that never expire, and channels as append-only streams for coordination. Free tier included — no setup required.
